{{Top|canon=Split saber}}
[[File:InterlockingHilt-NEGWT.png|thumb|right|250px|Asajj Ventress' paired lightsabers.]]

'''Interlocking hilt''', also known as '''paired lightsabers''', '''locking lightsabers''', or '''form shifting lightsabers''', were dual [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] that could be joined together at the hilt into a single weapon, either by a locking mechanism, becoming a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]], or by a fiber cord, where they would be flailed about by the cord.

==History and use==
[[File:BlankSlate1.jpg|thumb|left|Asajj Ventress joining her paired lightsabers during her duel with Mace Windu.]]
One of the earlier users of paired lightsabers was the [[Sith Blademaster]] [[Kas'im]], who used the paired function to disguise his two lightsabers as a single saberstaff, before splitting it into two separate weapons. He used this tactic to great effect [[Duel on Lehon|against]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] on [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]].<ref name="DBPOD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>

[[Komari Vosa]] was known to have wielded paired lightsabers.<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> After Vosa's death, [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|her lightsabers]] were given to [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] by her former master, [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="CW7">{{CW|7}}</ref> The weapons included both types of joining, being connectible by both the locking mechanism<ref name="JMW">''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]''</ref> and a fiber cord. Ventress often utilized the locking mechanism, wielding the weapons as a double-bladed lightsaber. Though she would normally use the locking mechanisim, when connected by the fiber cord, the weapon was more difficult to control than a regular double-bladed saber, however, the curved hilts and the fiber cord joint of her saber gave the wielder the benefit of striking from unexpected angles.<ref name="SWB2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' {{C|Xbox Live content}}</ref> Ventress' skill with the weapons was impressive, but not enough to defeat seasoned Jedi such as [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]<ref name="JMW" /> or [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="R60">[[Republic 60|''Republic'' 60]]</ref>

One of the more recent users of paired lightsabers was the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], [[Sa Cuis]]. However, it appeared that Cuis only used the paired function for easy storage, wielding his lightsabers separately in combat.<ref name="IHI">{{StoryCite|story=In His Image|book=Vader: The Ultimate Guide}}</ref>
